subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain a channel-local retry after the shared fenced reply-session self-heal, or should this PR wait for that root fix and be retested first?
rationale: Both approaches can prevent message loss, but carrying both changes hot-path recovery semantics and complexity; repository evidence cannot determine the intended defense-in-depth policy.

options.title: Validate shared self-heal first
options.body: Review and land the proof-positive shared repair, then reproduce the Discord thread race before adding channel-local retry.

options.title: Require Discord retry parity
options.body: Keep channel defense-in-depth, but retry below one-time recording, make backoff abortable, and prove the live Discord path.

recommendation.title: Validate shared self-heal first
recommendation.body: Review and land the proof-positive shared repair, then reproduce the Discord thread race before adding channel-local retry.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history owns the guarded shared initialization boundary at the center of the root-versus-channel recovery choice.
